name: Current River — Baptist to Two Rivers
blurb: The upper Current River in Ozark National Scenic Riverways: spring-fed water between NPS landings from Baptist to Two Rivers, with NPS float-time estimates.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Baptist: approximate area only. Take-out Cedar Grove: exact agency access pin. Ozark National Scenic Riverways: at high river levels the park implements temporary river closures for both commercial and non-commercial vessels. ONSR superintendent's compendium: the compendium sets maximum motor horsepower by river reach. ONSR compendium: the compendium regulates the practice of lashing vessels together and restricts alcoholic beverages in designated areas and periods. NPS paddle pages: "portions are only navigable during certain times due to low river levels." Check river levels and closures before departing. NPS-authorized outfitters (concessioners) rent canoes, kayaks, rafts and tubes and run shuttles inside the park. Missouri law: no glass beverage containers on canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in a sealed non-glass cooler; carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat; children under 7 wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: NPS park brochure river miles.

guideTimes.conditions: NPS estimated float time; NPS says times vary depending on the amount of water flow (page last updated April 28, 2021)
